featured_reviews.name: Minakshi a
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very rude and unprofessional staff. Avoid visiting between 7:30–8:30 AM.
During this time, the staff takes petrol tank readings and completely stops serving customers. They do not inform customers about what is happening or how long it will take.
The process often takes around 30 minutes, and many customers are forced to leave without refuelling due to frustration.
The staff’s attitude is extremely disrespectful—they behave as if they own the pump and customers are begging for service. This is unacceptable and needs immediate improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Soni Rakhra
featured_reviews.review_text: Staff's are not supportive at all... Queue for 2 wheelers was increasing but they didn't agree for other station to carry 2 wheeler fuel ... That's too bad

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text: Staff here is up to scamming people. They will ask you to make payment first and then fill the petrol. Nowhere in any petrol pump in India this system followed. Also staff has no manners to talk to women and just know how to talk in a cheap manner. BPCL really needs to provide basic behavioural training to the staff here.

featured_reviews.name: Sarvagya Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text: Great place to fill your vehicle with petrol and diesel or CNG if required.... You can bargain with the service staff and they will acknowledge your request to no avail..... Mostly crowded at night with happening crowd waiting in queue to get drinks for their vehicles. Nice ambience and lighting enough too see the zero on the petrol pump meter. Has a toilet and an air station as well for your vehicle to get some fresh air..... Must visit place near Metro mall in case you vehicle needs a refill.

featured_reviews.name: TRUSHANT SAGVEKAR
featured_reviews.review_text: The petrol station is equipped with CNG pump and conveniently located on the main road for easily accessibility. quick services and well maintained. staff are also cooperative.

featured_reviews.name: Anupam Sil
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are definitely billing issues here, especially with petrol cars. Beware of filling without physically getting down to check the zero set. The staff has various tricks to divert your attention and start the fill without zero set, thereby you end up with less petrol. Done more often if the vehicle in front is a bike which fills a small amount of petrol and therefore you cannot confirm if the reading is right or wrong. Fuel quality is good, I fill here every two days for the past 8 years but never break the routine of getting down and ensuring zero set.

Recent update of photos, this happened on 25th June 2018, caught them red handed. Look closely you can see how he has kept the nozzle in the adjacent compartment so that there is no zero set happening before the operator starts filling for you.

All I did was look slightly to one side when he completed filling the small material carrier in front of me who filled about Rs.100 of diesel. Immediately the operator kept the nozzle to the side waiting for my car to come into position.

Please learn and ensure you have a strict routine of getting down and seeing the zero set to avoid being duped.

featured_reviews.name: Zenobe Mansoor Ali
featured_reviews.review_text: Petrol pump is open all the time at per the timing given. Here you can get change as you will  have difficulty in  having change of rupees. The workers here are polite and very helpful to you. It lies on the LBS marg as you pass you can fill your petrol and could have a  nice journey.

featured_reviews.name: Joan Johnson
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very bad experience
Started filling without showing zero reading and i questioned but Most of the staff came together to fight with me , all most all the staff are very rude and arrogant.
Be careful, don't go to this worst petrol pump.

- A S Sahney, Chairman, IndianOil

It has come to our attention that a notice regarding ethanol-blended petrol, purportedly bearing the logos of various Oil Marketing Companies, is circulating on social media. Please note that this is an old, unauthorized message that has been circulating for some time and does not reflect our official communications.

IndianOil supplies fuels strictly in accordance with IS 17021:2018 specifications and all applicable quality standards. E20 fuel is a homogeneous, scientifically validated product specifically designed for safe vehicular use. Although ethanol is naturally hygroscopic, modern vehicles are engineered with sealed fuel systems to prevent water ingress. 

The introduction of E20 petrol in India followed extensive testing and validation by automobile manufacturers and industry experts. Since its rollout, there have been no credible reports of engine failures or performance issues directly attributable to ethanol blending. E20 is safe for use in all compatible vehicles.

IndianOil strongly advises customers not to rely on or circulate unverified messages.
